notes: structuring: repeated cash deposits of Rs 45,000-49,900 spread across 3 accounts
round_trip: money leaves a controller, passes 2-3 shell firms, returns within days
pass_through: many small credits forwarded out within 0-1 day (mule behaviour)
income_mismatch / non_filer: bank credits far above declared income or no return filed
round_cash: repeated cash withdrawals of exactly Rs 2.5L / 5L / 10L
gst_circular: shell firms invoice each other in a ring every month (mostly no e-way bills)
gst_risky_itc: 3 ordinary-looking firms claim ITC on paper invoices bought from shell firms
gst_itc_passthrough: shell firms pay almost no GST in cash; credit offsets all output tax
